items.q: In excel, how do I use Italic?
items.answer:
To use Italic in Excel, you can use the following VBA code snippet:

```vb
With Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("B2:D6")
    .Font.Italic = True
End With
```

This code sets the font style for cells B2:D6 on Sheet1 of the active workbook to ital
